About the Team:

Grindr is an AI-native platform powering how millions of gay people connect globally. With 15M+ monthly users, 130B+ annual messages, and a team of fewer than 200, we move fast, stay lean, and tackle technical problems at a scale few companies ever see.

As a Staff Data Scientist at Grindr, you will be working closely with product managers, product designers, and engineers to devise insightful metrics that guide development, design and execute novel experiments, present a data-driven viewpoint to guide key decisions, and find new avenues to drive growth through deep dive analysis. You will have the opportunity to work on models that are deployed to production and improve quality of life for our millions of users. You will also be an informal ambassador for the Data Science team to the rest of the organization, educating a diverse group on the many subtle aspects of utilizing data well. You will be a member of the data organization at Grindr, which integrates data scientists, data engineers, and ML/AI engineers into a single cohesive and collaborative team. This is a rare opportunity to learn, teach, and have an outsized impact alongside some of the top minds in the field.

At Grindr, we operate in Grindr Mode. Moderately hardcore day to day, truly hardcore when it counts. It’s about doing great work without burning out. Outcomes over outputs. Smart, driven people who raise your bar, with room to live full lives.

This is a hybrid role based in our Bay Area, Los Angeles, or Chicago offices and will require you to be in office Tuesdays and Thursdays.

**Our Mission  
**

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from *seeking* to *getting*. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your Impact on our Mission:

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join Zocdoc's Marketing Science team. The team partners across our Marketing organization, including Patient, Provider, and Brand Marketing, to measure, optimize, and scale marketing efforts.

In this role, you'll independently own complex analytical workstreams, develop data-driven insights that inform channel strategy, campaign optimization, lifecycle engagement, and brand effectiveness, and work closely with Marketing, Product, Finance, and Engineering partners to ensure measurement rigor and actionable outcomes. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant influence and deep partnership with Marketing and Product leadership.

You don't need prior marketing experience to be successful in this role. We're looking for a strong analytical thinker who is excited to apply rigorous quantitative methods to questions about growth, engagement, effectiveness, and customer behavior — and interested in developing deeper expertise in marketing science.

You’ll Enjoy This Role If You…

* Attribution, Incrementality & Experimentation**:**Design and analyze marketing attribution studies, incrementality tests, and rigorous experiments — including geo tests, lift studies, and A/B tests — to quantify the true impact of Zocdoc's marketing investments and translate results into clear business recommendations.
    
* Brand & Marketing Performance: Analyze and synthesize performance across paid, owned, and brand channels and across patient and provider audiences. Identify trends, quantify impact, and recommend optimizations. Build and evolve brand measurement frameworks, such as brand lift studies, media mix modeling, and awareness tracking, to connect marketing investments to downstream business outcomes.
    
* Lifecycle & Engagement Analytics: Evaluate engagement, activation, rebooking, and long-term retention across customer and provider audiences and CRM touchpoints, including email, push, and SMS. Identify opportunities to improve the overall marketplace experience and business outcomes.
    
* Performance Data Assets:Collaborate with Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering to build and operationalize core marketing performance data assets and dashboards, enabling reliable self-serve reporting and consistent performance monitoring across channels and audiences.
    
* Executive Storytelling: Create clear, compelling presentations, dashboards, and recommendations that influence strategic decisions at the leadership level.
    

You’ll be successful in this role if you…

* Have 5+ years of experience in data science, analytics, marketing science, marketing analytics, growth analytics, product analytics, business analytics, or a similar quantitative role.
* Have deep expertise in SQL and strong proficiency in Python or R.
* Have strong experience with experimentation design, causal inference, incrementality testing, attribution, or other rigorous approaches to measuring impact — and a track record of owning analytical workstreams end-to-end.
* Have familiarity with marketing measurement approaches, such as media mix modeling, brand lift studies, or awareness and perception tracking, or a strong interest in developing this expertise.
* Can independently frame complex, ambiguous analytical problems and drive them from question through to recommendation.
* Are fluent in translating complex quantitative findings into business-relevant insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Have a strong foundation in statistical concepts, including causal inference, experimentation, and predictive modeling.
* Are detail-oriented, proactive, and thrive in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

* Unlimited Vacation

### **Our Mission**

As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing.

We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.

### **  
Our Values**

* **Take the Lead:** We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
* **Move Fast:** We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
* **Better Together:** We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
* **Real Talk:** We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
* **Safety First:** We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
* **Spark Fun:** We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.

  

**Program Duration**

The internship program will run from June 1 through August 31, 2027.

**Where you’ll work**

This is a hybrid role that requires in-office collaboration three days per week in San Francisco.

**About the Role**

As a Data Scientist Intern at Tinder, you’ll help us uncover insights from one of the world’s largest datasets to enhance user experience, strengthen safety, and drive innovation across our platform. You’ll work alongside talented engineers, data scientists, and product teams to solve real-world problems using data-driven approaches that shape the future of how people connect.

### What you'll do:

* Design and execute A/B experiments to measure the impact of product features and algorithmic changes.
    
* Help build and improve the team’s experimentation and analytics tooling, including AI-assisted workflows, with a focus on standardization, automation, and clear documentation.
    
* Take a scoped analysis from question to recommendation, with guidance from your mentor.
    
* Collaborate with cross-functional partners in Data Science, Product, and Engineering to translate insights into actionable strategies.
    
* Present key findings and project outcomes to Product and Leadership teams during end-of-internship demos.
    
* Translate data insights into clear narratives and recommendations that inform product roadmaps and user experience improvements.
    
* Explore and analyze large-scale datasets to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities.
    

### What we're looking for:

* Passion for using data and experimentation to solve complex problems.
    
* Intermediate to advanced SQL skills for data querying and analysis.
    
* Familiarity with / building to proficiency in Python.
    
* Strong foundation in statistics, probability, and experimental design (A/B testing, hypothesis testing).
    
* Clear written communication and a curious, fast-learning mindset.
    
* Comfort using AI tools (e.g., LLM-based coding and analysis assistants) as a regular part of your workflow, and the judgment to check their output.
    
* Currently pursuing a BS/BA, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, Statistics, Applied Math, or a related field.
    

Commitment to Inclusion

At Tinder, we don’t just accept difference, we celebrate it. We strive to build a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members around the world, and we value unique perspectives and backgrounds. Even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications, we invite you to apply and show us how your skills could transfer. Tinder is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where we welcome people of all sexes, gender identities, races, ethnicities, disabilities, and other lived experiences. Learn more here: [https://www.lifeattinder.com/dei](https://www.lifeattinder.com/dei)

*If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please speak to your Talent Acquisition Partner directly.*

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.  

When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL).  We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.

  

# **The Team or Role:**

Match Group’s Analytics Team is looking for a Data Scientist II with expertise in Marketing Analytics.

Our analytics team serves the entire MG portfolio, acting as a center of excellence to standardize how we measure marketing performance across all our global brands, including industry leading names like Tinder and Hinge. We develop a deep understanding of the business and its data and establish close working relationships with all teams including Product, Marketing, Engineering, and Finance, so that we can provide recommendations and make proposals regarding prioritization of initiatives, marketing investments, A/B tests, and company performance.

As a data scientist in this role, you will partner with Marketing teams at each of our BUs, providing support through advanced marketing measurement techniques, A/B test design and analysis, and data-driven insights through ad-hoc analyses, presentations, and automated reports and dashboards. This role will require extensive experience with SQL, data wrangling, statistics, econometric modeling, and A/B testing, as well as the ability to work in cross-functional teams to drive actionable insights. Experience with user growth and acquisition across multi-brand consumer products is a plus.

# **Where you’ll work:**

This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three days per week. This position is located in NYC or Los Angeles.

### In this role, you will:

* Master and be responsible for analyzing marketing and business performance.
    
* Build models better to understand the impact of our marketing investments and strategy
    
* Find the “story” in the data and communicate insights and opportunities with executives and other internal teams.
    
* Perform ongoing ad-hoc analyses to evaluate the efficiency of our marketing spend, build reporting infrastructure, and assist in making budgeting recommendations to optimize growth.

* Support reporting and business intelligence needs of the entire Marketing team.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint (or equivalents)
    
* Familiarity with common marketing KPIs, metrics, and growth experiments

Fin's **GTM Data Science** team builds the machine learning behind our Growth, Marketing and Sales teams. Our models decide which leads become MQLs, how they're routed, what they're worth, which play a rep runs next, how marketing spend is attributed, and which customers are ready to expand.

We already run many production models, including lead scoring, lead value, next best play, multi-touch attribution, marketing mix modeling and customer expansion. * Set up the monitoring, alerting and tests each new model needs
* Measure lift after launch and report what changed

You'll learn how a model goes from notebook to production, and own that path.

* Ship at least one prototype into production and measure its lift

* Solid foundations in statistics: distributions, hypothesis testing, model evaluation
* Comfort with version control (GitHub) and code review
* Familiarity with dbt, Snowflake, Airflow or Salesforce is a plus

* An owner: you follow an issue to its root cause and close the loop with the person who raised it

* Curious: you dig into the "why" when a metric moves
* AI-first: you use AI tools to work faster, and you know when to check their output
